content: The Durable Task extension for Microsoft Agent Framework is now generally available for C# and Python. Build agents, multi-agent orchestrations, and Microsoft Agent Framework workflows that can run reliably for minutes, days, or weeks. The extension persists agent sessions, checkpoints orchestration and workflow progress, and automatically resumes work after LLM rate limits, network timeouts, process restarts, scale events, or infrastructure failures without requiring custom recovery logic. The extension supports two hosting models. Customers can use Azure Functions for managed, serverless hosting with automatic scaling and generated HTTP endpoints, or bring their own compute using containers, Kubernetes, services, or existing application infrastructure. Completed work is preserved and can resume on another worker without losing conversation context or repeating completed steps. Key capabilities include persistent conversation history, deterministic multi-agent orchestration, durable Agent Framework graph workflows, human-in-the-loop waits, external events, session time-to-live cleanup, reliable streaming, and visibility through the Durable Task Scheduler dashboard. Learn more.
